transform_direction_with_yaw_pitch: transform a direction vector using yaw and pitch angles with optional inversion for viewer to canonical coordinate conversion
compute_yaw_pitch_from_look_vector: compute yaw and pitch angles from a 3D look vector using arctan2 for horizontal and vertical angle extraction
generate_look_vector_from_yaw_pitch: generate a 3D look vector from yaw and pitch angles using trigonometric functions for direction computation
build_rotation_matrix_for_axis: build a rotation matrix for X, Y, or Z axis given an angle in degrees using standard rotation matrix formulas
use_direction_constants_for_transforms: use predefined direction constants like FRONT BACK LEFT RIGHT UP DOWN as numpy arrays for coordinate transformation inputs
